summary: Brookfield Wealth Solutions Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on May 4, 2026, containing a notice of its annual general and special meeting scheduled for July 16, 2026, with a record date of May 29, 2026. The meeting covers routine annual and special business for multiple classes of shares. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, or other special situation is disclosed. This is a routine administrative filing regarding meeting logistics and voting procedures, with no economic terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural considerations. There is no transaction to analyze; the filing is purely procedural and does not warrant a special-situations classification.
